description: An opaque floor-length burgundy square-neck court gown has broad gold patterned borders, a fitted bodice, decorated waist belt and short elbow-length sleeves. Round brooches sit at the two neckline corners. A cream patterned mantle drapes around the forearms and falls down both sides. A round gold pendant, small earrings, bracelet and rings complete the court accessories. Both hands rest visibly together in front of the waist. One patterned flat shoe is visible beneath the front hem; the remaining footwear is concealed by the long skirt. There is no armour, headgear or weapon.
